basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/Pathlock_PLC/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. The [Pathlock Cloud Event Log](https://pathlock.com/products/application-access-governance/) integration enables organizations to seamlessly forward Pathlock Cloud process events from Processes and Workflows for unified visibility and correlation across the enterprise. This connector utilizes the Common Connector Platform (CCP) framework to securely transmit log and event data while maintaining data integrity and governance. The Custom Logs solution is automatically deployed during installation, ensuring a quick and reliable setup without manual configuration steps. With this integration, SOC and ERP security teams can: - Consolidate ERP-specific threat intelligence and correlate it with enterprise events in Microsoft Sentinel. - Automate alerting and response workflows in Microsoft Sentinel for faster mean-time-to-detect (MTTD) and mean-time-to-respond (MTTR). - Maintain audit readiness by demonstrating end-to-end visibility of ERP workflow activities. This out-of-the-box connector simplifies secure event forwarding from PLC to Microsoft Sentinel—enabling centralized analysis, compliance reporting, and proactive response within your existing security ecosystem. **Data Connectors:** 1 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)
